In the first Bohr orbit the potential energy is **−27·2 eV** and the total **−13·6 eV**.
**Step 1 — write the potential energy.** The electron sits at r = a₀ from a proton:
E_P = **−ke²/r** ✓
= −(9 x 10⁹)(1·6 x 10⁻¹⁹)²/(5·3 x 10⁻¹¹)
= −4·35 x 10⁻¹⁸ J ✓
**Step 2 — convert to electron-volts.**
= −4·35 x 10⁻¹⁸/1·6 x 10⁻¹⁹
= **−27·2 eV** ✓
**Step 3 — find the kinetic energy.** The Coulomb attraction supplies the centripetal
force:
ke²/r² = mv²/r, so mv² = ke²/r ✓
E_K = ½mv² = **+ke²/2r = +13·6 eV** ✓ exactly half the magnitude of E_P.
**Step 4 — add them for the total.**
E_T = 13·6 + (−27·2)
= **−13·6 eV** ✓
**The three relations worth memorising.**
E_K = **−E_T** ✓
E_P = **2E_T** ✓
E_P = **−2E_K** ✓
Knowing any one of the three gives the other two at once.
**Why the potential energy is negative.** The zero is taken with the electron **at
infinity** ✓ Bringing it closer to the proton releases energy, so the bound state lies
below zero. The deeper the binding, the more negative.
**Why the kinetic energy is positive.** It is ½mv², and a speed is real ✓ The electron
must move to stay in orbit, and that motion carries genuine positive energy.
**Why the total is negative.** The attraction outweighs the motion ✓ A negative total
energy **is** the definition of a bound state: 13·6 eV must be supplied to free the
electron, which is hydrogen's ionisation energy.
**The virial theorem, which this illustrates.** For an inverse-square force,
2⟨E_K⟩ = **−⟨E_P⟩** ✓ a general result holding for planetary orbits as much as for
atoms - which is why a satellite given extra energy ends up moving **slower**, in a
higher orbit.
**The electron's speed here.**
v = √(2E_K/m) = √(2 x 2·18 x 10⁻¹⁸/9·11 x 10⁻³¹) = **2·19 x 10⁶ m s⁻¹** ✓ about
**c/137** - the fine-structure constant, and small enough that relativistic corrections
are tiny but measurable.
**Why the first orbit is 0·53 Å.** It follows from quantising the angular momentum,
mvr = nℏ ✓ Combined with the force equation this gives r = n²ℏ²/(mke²), whose n = 1
value is the **Bohr radius**, a₀ = 5·29 x 10⁻¹¹ m.
**Reading the distractors.** **E_P = +27·2** ✗ reverses the sign of a bound state.
**E_P = −13·6, E_T = +13·6** ✗ interchanges the two, and **E_P = −6·8** ✗ halves the
potential energy instead of doubling the total ✓
∴ E_P = – 27.2 eV, E_T = – 13.6 eV.

Falling to the ground state, the electron **speeds up**: kinetic energy rises while
potential and total energies fall.
**Step 1 — write the three energies for level n.**
E_T = **−13·6/n² eV** ✓
E_K = **+13·6/n² eV** = −E_T ✓
E_P = **−27·2/n² eV** = 2E_T ✓
**Step 2 — see what happens as n falls.** Every term carries **1/n²**, which **grows**
as n decreases ✓
E_K = +13·6/n²: the positive term grows, so E_K **increases** ✓
E_P = −27·2/n²: the negative term grows in magnitude, so E_P **decreases** (becomes more
negative) ✓
E_T = −13·6/n²: likewise **decreases** ✓
**Step 3 — conclude.** Kinetic energy **increases**; potential and total energies
**decrease** ✓
**A worked instance, n = 3 → n = 1.**
E_K: 1·51 → **13·6 eV**, up by 12·09 ✓
E_P: −3·02 → **−27·2 eV**, down by 24·18 ✓
E_T: −1·51 → **−13·6 eV**, down by 12·09 ✓
and the photon carries away exactly **12·09 eV** ✓ - the drop in total energy, as
energy conservation demands.
**Why the electron speeds up while losing energy.** The potential energy falls **twice
as fast** as the total ✓ so half of what is lost to the photon comes out of the
potential well and the other half goes into **kinetic** energy. The virial theorem,
2E_K = −E_P, enforces this exactly.
**The same thing in orbital mechanics.** A satellite losing energy to atmospheric drag
spirals **inwards** and moves **faster** ✓ The "satellite paradox" - drag speeds a
satellite up - is this identical result, and it surprises people in both contexts.
**Why only the total energy appears in the photon.**
hν = **E_initial − E_final** ✓ The kinetic and potential energies are internal
bookkeeping; the photon registers only the change in the total.
**Why the total must decrease.** The atom **emits** ✓ It cannot radiate energy away and
end up with more than it began with. Any option leaving E_T unchanged is excluded at
once.
**The speed in each orbit.**
v_n = **2·19 x 10⁶/n m s⁻¹** ✓ so the ground-state electron moves three times faster
than one in n = 3 - and its kinetic energy is nine times greater.
**The stability of the ground state.** n = 1 is the **lowest** available ✓ There is
nowhere further to fall, which is why hydrogen atoms do not collapse and why matter is
stable - a fact classical electromagnetism could not explain at all.
**How to attack such questions.** Write all three energies with their signs and let n
decrease ✓ The 1/n² factor then settles each one mechanically, with no intuition
required.
**Reading the distractors.** Any option with the kinetic energy **decreasing** ✗
contradicts E_K = 13·6/n². "Total energy remains same" ✗ would mean no photon was
emitted at all ✓
∴ Its kinetic energy increases but potential energy and total energy decrease.
